marketLayer.title: US Tech & Semiconductor Sector
marketLayer.fact: Major US semiconductor giants traded mixed as robust demand for next-generation AI accelerators was counterbalanced by potential updates to international export compliance policies.
marketLayer.inference: High-valuation tech equities remain hyper-sensitive to geopolitical policy shifts, even as baseline infrastructure spending on AI computing power stays strong.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Final regulatory scope of tech export restrictions and upcoming corporate guidance on gross margin sustainability.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet & Platform Economy
marketLayer.fact: HK-listed Chinese internet heavyweights logged selective gains following earnings reports that highlighted disciplined cost management and increased share buyback programs.
marketLayer.inference: Capital flows are favoring cash-generative internet firms prioritizing shareholder returns and operational efficiency over aggressive market-share expansion.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of domestic consumer sentiment recovery and competitive intensity in core e-commerce and local services.

marketLayer.title: Global Macro & HK Liquidity Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: US inflation metrics aligned closely with forecasts, reinforcing market expectations for central bank policy easing later in the year and pushing Treasury yields lower.
marketLayer.inference: Easing US yields offer room for HIBOR (Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate) to soften, providing liquidity relief to local equity valuations and real estate capital costs.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sticky service-sector inflation data in the US and broader macroeconomic growth trajectory in Mainland China.
